queries.query: how does the local code search rank its results?
queries.answer: searchIndex embeds the query as a hashed sparse TF-IDF vector (queryVector adds related concept words such as login/authenticate for 'sign in' at weight 0.4), scores each stored chunk by cosine similarity with IDF recomputed from stored document frequencies, adds small boosts for query words in the chunk's symbol name (+0.12 each, capped 0.36) and path (+0.05 each, capped 0.15), sorts and returns the top k (default 8).
queries.note: The design concept spans search.ts (scoring) and tokenize.ts (vectors, concept expansion); chunker.ts and store.ts are about indexing, and docs/README mention the feature only in prose.

queries.query: when a held stock flips to non-compliant, how does the system end up selling it and working out what to donate?
queries.answer: At each quarterly rebalance clock.rebalance re-screens every held ticker and feeds the verdict to compliance_state.transition: a NON_COMPLIANT verdict moves HELD_COMPLIANT to HELD_NONCOMPLIANT_GRACE (grace countdown from fiqh params, default 1 rebalance); when the countdown reaches 0 the record becomes DIVESTED, transition returns a DivestmentEvent and rebalance sells the position at that rebalance's price. Later purify_backtest_result calls compute_divestment_attribution for each divestment event only when purify_capital_gains is on: max(0, quantity * (price_at_divest - price_at_flip)).

queries.query: walk me through how a ticker gets its Pure, Mixed or Non-compliant verdict
queries.answer: screen() resolves CIK and SIC from the offline cache and runs classify_business_activity (an override map entry wins, otherwise SIC_TIER_MAP with the tier-0.5/tier-1 toggles); a Layer-1 failure returns NON_COMPLIANT immediately. Otherwise it resolves the denominator and numerators from DuckDB and compute_financial_ratio_screen checks debt/denominator <= 30%, interest investments/denominator <= 30% and non-permissible income/total revenue <= 5%. Any failure is NON_COMPLIANT; all three ratios exactly 0.0 is PURE; otherwise MIXED. Every screen adds a reason-trace entry.

queries.query: why does the sandbox give idle cash zero return instead of a risk-free rate?
queries.answer: MASTER_PRD.md section 2 makes CASH_YIELD = 0.0 an invariant: idle cash earns nothing (no T-bill, money-market or risk-free sweep) because idle-cash yield is riba (interest); the resulting cash drag is considered correct and must be visible in results.
queries.note: invariants.py and portfolio.apply_cash_yield implement it but never say why; PHASE_5_SPEC.md mentions the zero yield only as bookkeeping.

queries.query: why isn't there a gambling SIC code in the business-activity map, and where do casino companies get caught?
queries.answer: SIC 7993 (named as illustrative in PHASE_4_SPEC.md) is not an SEC-assigned code and has no filers, so SIC_TIER_MAP omits it; real casino issuers such as Wynn and Caesars file under SIC 7011 (Hotels & Motels), which is Tier 1, so they are only caught when business_activity_tier_1_enabled is on or via a hand-researched override.
queries.note: PHASE_4_SPEC.md still names 7993 (the wrong, superseded claim) and ranks highly for 'gambling SIC'; the correction lives in the modernization log and a code comment.
